messages.content: You are an expert software test engineer who designs test cases with the decision table technique. Reply with JSON only.

BUSINESS RULES
The program reads three integer side lengths a, b and c and classifies the triangle they form. If any one side is greater than or equal to the sum of the other two sides, the three sides cannot form a triangle and the output is "Not a triangle". Otherwise, the output is "Equilateral" if all three sides are equal, "Isosceles" if exactly two sides are equal, and "Scalene" if no two sides are equal.

INPUTS
- a: integer from 1 to 200 (side length)
- b: integer from 1 to 200 (side length)
- c: integer from 1 to 200 (side length)

OUTPUT
- triangle_type: one of "Not a triangle", "Scalene", "Isosceles", "Equilateral"

TASK
Below is the decision table you built for these business rules. An automated checker evaluated it on many input values and found the problems listed after it. Fix the table so that every valid input matches exactly one rule and the outputs follow the business rules. Return the complete corrected table as JSON in the same format: {"conditions": [{"id", "expr"}], "rules": [{"id", "when", "output"}]}. Each condition is a yes/no test written as a Python boolean expression that uses only the input names above, numbers, quoted text values, and the operators < <= > >= == != and or not + - * / % in. Examples: "age >= 18", "weather == 'rainy'", "a + b > c", "month in (4, 6, 9, 11)".

DECISION TABLE
{"conditions":[{"id":"C1","expr":"a + b > c"},{"id":"C2","expr":"a == b"},{"id":"C3","expr":"a == c"},{"id":"C4","expr":"b == c"}],"rules":[{"id":"R1","when":{"C1":true,"C2":false,"C3":false,"C4":false},"output":"Not a triangle"},{"id":"R2","when":{"C1":false,"C2":true,"C3":false,"C4":false},"output":"Equilateral"},{"id":"R3","when":{"C1":false,"C2":false,"C3":true,"C4":false},"output":"Isosceles"},{"id":"R4","when":{"C1":false,"C2":false,"C3":false,"C4":true},"output":"Scalene"}]}

PROBLEMS FOUND
- Missing combination: no rule matches the input a=1, b=1, c=1 (C1=true, C2=true, C3=true, C4=true).
- Missing combination: no rule matches the input a=1, b=2, c=1 (C1=true, C2=false, C3=true, C4=false).
- Missing combination: no rule matches the input a=1, b=2, c=2 (C1=true, C2=false, C3=false, C4=true).
- In total, 5 reachable combinations of your conditions match no rule and 0 match rules with different outputs.

response: {"conditions":[{"id":"C1","expr":"a + b > c"},{"id":"C2","expr":"a == b"},{"id":"C3","expr":"a == c"},{"id":"C4","expr":"b == c"},{"id":"C5","expr":"a == c and b == c"},{"id":"C6","expr":"a == b and b == c"},{"id":"C7","expr":"a == b and a == c"},{"id":"C8","expr":"a == b or a == c or b == c"}],"rules":[{"id":"R1","when":{"C1":true,"C2":false,"C3":false,"C4":false},"output":"Not a triangle"},{"id":"R2","when":{"C2":true,"C3":false,"C4":false},"output":"Equilateral"},{"id":"R3","when":{"C3":true,"C2":false,"C4":false},"output":"Isosceles"},{"id":"R4","when":{"C4":true,"C2":false,"C3":false},"output":"Scalene"},{"id":"R5","when":{"C5":true,"C6":false,"C7":false,"C8":false},"output":"Not a triangle"},{"id":"R6","when":{"C2":true,"C5":false,"C6":true,"C7":false,"C8":false},"output":"Isosceles"},{"id":"R7","when":{"C3":true,"C5":false,"C6":false,"C7":true,"C8":false},"output":"Scalene"},{"id":"R8","when":{"C4":true,"C5":false,"C6":false,"C7":false,"C8":true},"output":"Scalene"},{"id":"R9","when":{"C1":false,"C2":false,"C3":false,"C4":false},"output":"Scalene"}]}

conditions.expr: a == b or a == c or b == c
